speaker: alice
text: Starting with our green news Alex, and this one's got me excited about the future of transport. Aus Ships and Volvo Penta have just announced they're building Australia's first fully electric passenger ferry.

speaker: charlie
text: That's massive Jamie! Due for completion in Q4 this year, this isn't just good for the environment - it's proper Aussie ingenuity solving real problems. No more diesel fumes, just quiet electric power cutting through our beautiful waterways.

speaker: alice
text: And speaking of Aussie pride, Queensland is celebrating Dinosaur Week right now. Did you know we're home to over 80% of Australia's dinosaur fossil discoveries? From tiny raptors to massive sauropods, Queensland's ancient history is world-class.
